justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayUtils.java`; it is a 9,321-line class with 393 `public static` methods. The class bundles several separable concerns in one unit: array growth/removal (`add*`, `remove*`), searching (`contains`, `indexOf`, `lastIndexOf`), predicates (`isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty`), reordering (`reverse`, `shuffle`, `swap`), and conversions/formatting (`toObject`, `toPrimitive`, `toMap`, `toStringArray`), which is strong evidence of insufficient modularization and low cohesion.
